item: are of the same cell type
caption: 12,252 unstimulated blood immune cells (PBMCs) of eight donors, measured in one 10x experiment (Kang et al., 2018) and coloured by annotated cell type. Cells are linked to their ten nearest cells in expression space, computed on principal components fitted to the reference donors only. FlingVis was fitted to the 3,905 cells of the two reference donors, and each further donor is mapped onto it without refitting.
